name: Static quads
movement: the thigh tightened, the back of the knee pressed to the floor and the toes pulled up, held

phone.placement: Lay the phone on its side on the floor, two or three metres away, side on to where you will be.

words.hint: Lying with one leg straight: toes pulled up, knee pressed down, held five seconds.
words.start: Lay the phone on its side on the floor. Lie on your back side on to it, one knee bent, the other leg straight.
words.position: Lie on your back, side on to the phone, one knee bent with the foot flat, the other leg straight and relaxed, heel on the floor.
words.top: The toes pulled up toward you, the thigh tight and the back of the knee pressed into the floor, for the count.
howto: Lie on your back with one knee bent. The straight leg is the working leg.
Pull the toes of that foot back toward you and press the back of the knee down into the floor. Feel the thigh tighten; the heel may lift an inch, which is fine.
Hold for the count — five seconds — breathing.
Let go completely, toes relaxed, before the next one. The rep counts as you let go.
words.cannot: How hard the thigh is contracting: it sees the toes come up and the knee straighten, which go with the contraction, not the muscle itself. Press as hard as is comfortable.
words.about: Static quads — lying on your back side on: the foot's angle at the heel between toe and knee, which falls as the toes are pulled up; the contraction is under way once it is below 98° and let go past 110°; and the knee, at least 170° while it is held. Hold five seconds, then relax fully; the rep counts on letting go.
words.lost: Lie down side on to the camera, whole body in
words.early: Hold it for the full count next time
words.safety: Nothing should hurt: this is the gentlest knee exercise. A rolled towel under the knee helps if the thigh will not tighten.
words.easier: A shorter hold; a towel under the knee.
words.harder: A longer hold; more of them, every hour.
words.mistakes: Letting the knee bend; forgetting to pull the toes up; holding the breath.

measurements.label: toe, heel, knee
measurements.why: The foot against the shin, at the heel: relaxed it reads 110–125, toes pulled up 90 or less. The progress measurement: pulling the toes up is the start of the contraction, letting them go is the end.

measurements.label: knee pressed straight

settings.label: Knee angle, at least (180 is straight)

measurements.why: The knee kept straight: 180 is locked out. Below the band it is bending.

prompt.text: Toes up and press the knee down

faults.label: Knee not pressed down
faults.text: Press the back of your knee into the floor
faults.deep: Tighten the thigh — the knee is bent

faults.label: Toes not pulled up
faults.text: Pull your toes further toward you

settings.label: Foot angle that counts as toes up
